text:
Elaine: Quick kickoff — AcmeHealth strategic reseller POC starts tomorrow. Scope: shared tenant, data residency in eu-west-1, BYOK KMS, SSO (SAML). Need tech owners for network egress, telemetry, and pricing validation.
Jon Reseller: Thanks Elaine, happy to co-run. Our infra lead is @mike_reseller, will join. Can we get a tenant provisioned with EU-only storage?
Elaine: Yes, plan is a dedicated tenant in eu-west-1. @Olivia will own configs.
Olivia: I'll take tenant provisioning and mapping to their OrgID. Need org id and SSO SAML metadata.
Sam: Pricing note — reseller discount tier applies but need forecasted token volume for month1 and month3. Jon, any estimates?
Jon Reseller: Expecting ~500k tokens/mo initially, may spike to ~2M in month3 after pilot expansion.
Priya: For egress and KMS: BYOK flow supported. Need KMS key ARN and a cross-account grant. Also confirm whether HSM required.
Marco: Security checklist — they want ISO logs, weekly audit exports, and customer-managed KMS. We'll need to run a short survey: see questions below.
Marco: ```
1) KMS key ARN + admin contact
2) SAML metadata
3) Data retention policy (min/max)
4) Any regulatory controls (PCI/PHI)
```
Jon Reseller: They handle PHI. So HIPAA controls required.
Priya: HIPAA affects telemetry — we must ensure PII redaction in logs and disable request-level retention by default. We'll add a config flag.
Olivia: Runbook item: enable prefix caching for embeddings to save cost. We'll coordinate with Redwood Optimize team.
Sam: For the pilot quote I'll run numbers with 500k tokens and embedding calls (20k) — will share a pdf by EOD.
Elaine: Action items:
- Jon: get org id + SAML metadata + KMS contact (today)
- Olivia: provision eu-west-1 tenant (by tomorrow)
- Priya: prepare egress/KMS guide + HIPAA telemetry config (48h)
- Marco: send security questionnaire (today)
- Sam: draft pilot quote (EOD)
Jon Reseller: On it. Adding @mike_reseller to thread.
mike_reseller: looping in infra. KMS will be customer-hosted, confirm if we need cross-account IAM role or direct grant.
Priya: Direct grant preferred, but we can support cross-account role if key policy forbids grants.
Marco: Also, can we get a signed BAA before any PHI access? Legal to confirm.
Elaine: Yes, legal is on it.
deploy-bot: Tenant provisioning job queued: job_id=deploy-7721 status=queued
Olivia: FYI — tenant provisioning might need a manual network setup for their firewall rules. Jon, can you share IP allowlist?
Jon Reseller: Sharing now: 34.210.12.0/24, 18.194.33.0/24
Priya: Noted. We'll add them to staging allowlist and schedule a connectivity test.
Elaine: Great. Let's sync 1pm PT tomorrow for 30m. Meeting invite incoming. :calendar:
Jon Reseller: Works for me.
Sam: If anything blocks quote, ping me in #sales.
Olivia: Will post tenant details here once ready.
Marco: I'll send the security questionnaire in a separate thread with checkboxes.
Elaine: Thanks team — momentum looks good. Keep updates short here.
